description: A plan to change how existing trips are made — mode, time and necessity — through programs, incentives and partnerships rather than construction.
scope_notes: This is a standard-practice starting point — edit to your scope. Rename, delete and add records until the list matches the work your agency actually agreed to do.

Every date is calculated forward from the kickoff date you enter. The offsets are round numbers reflecting how this kind of work is usually sequenced — they are placeholders for a real schedule, not commitments.
It assumes measures the agency can actually deliver or require. Where a measure depends on employers or developers, name the partner in the record rather than leaving the action ownerless.
A measure with no monitoring is a measure nobody can defend later, which is why the monitoring framework is a deliverable rather than a chapter.

No jurisdiction is assumed. Review periods, required notices, hearings and the body that adopts the work are set where you are; none of them are stated here. Add the records your own process requires.
Nobody is assigned. Applying a template never puts a colleague's name on a deadline — assign the records yourself once the team is settled.

deliverables.title: Work plan and partner list
deliverables.summary: The task list, the schedule, and the employers, institutions and operators whose participation the plan assumes.

deliverables.title: Commute and travel behavior baseline
deliverables.summary: How people travel today, from surveys and available data, stated with its sample and its limits.

deliverables.title: Review of existing programs and incentives
deliverables.summary: What is already offered, who uses it, and what it has achieved.

deliverables.title: Candidate measures and expected effects
deliverables.summary: Each candidate measure with the evidence for its effect, the population it reaches and what it requires to run.

deliverables.title: Monitoring framework and performance measures
deliverables.summary: What will be measured, how often, and what result would count as the program working.

deliverables.title: Draft travel demand management plan
deliverables.summary: The complete draft with measures, partners and the monitoring commitment.

milestones.title: Project kickoff meeting
milestones.summary: Scope, partners and the survey approach confirmed.

milestones.title: Travel survey closes
milestones.summary: The baseline survey window ends so analysis can begin.

milestones.title: Employer and institution workshop
milestones.summary: The partners whose participation the plan depends on see the measures before they are proposed.

milestones.title: Review of the draft plan opens
milestones.summary: The draft is released to partners and the public for comment.

milestones.title: Adoption of the plan
milestones.summary: Adoption or acceptance by the sponsoring body.
